name: Ball Lightning
description: An unexplained atmospheric electrical phenomenon described as a luminous, typically spherical object ranging from a few centimetres to over a metre across, usually associated with thunderstorms and lasting from a fraction of a second to over a minute.
origin: Ball lightning has been reported globally, with high concentrations of reports in Europe, Russia, North America, and East Asia. Reports are not strongly geographically constrained but track regions with frequent thunderstorm activity and engaged scientific reporting cultures.
